security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline parameter names, and documentation links. One low-risk remote image embed and one medium-risk inline shell JSON pattern remain because they can affect privacy or command construction when used by agents. No prompt injection attempt or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Inline JSON is shown inside shell commands for user prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer the documented input-file workflow for generated prompts, and serialize JSON instead of interpolating raw user text into shell commands.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a marketplace-hosted image or proxy remote media so viewing the skill does not contact a third-party host directly.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on a hosted inference service.
remediation.suggestion: Keep disclosure clear that prompts and reference image URLs are sent to inference.sh during generation or editing.

semantic_findings.title: Potential Shell Argument Injection Through Inline JSON
semantic_findings.description: Several examples pass prompt JSON directly to infsh inside single-quoted shell arguments. If an agent inserts untrusted prompt text into this pattern without safe JSON serialization or shell escaping, quotes in the prompt could alter the command.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples show inline shell JSON, and prompt text is user controlled in normal skill use. The later input-file workflow reduces the risk, so confidence is medium.

content.value_statement: Text-heavy image prompts often need precise layout and readable typography. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to generate or edit images with Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Generates images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh CLI.
Creates poster, banner, logo, product, and abstract art prompt examples.
Shows reference-image editing with one to three input images.
Documents width, height, seed, image count, watermark, and prompt controls.
Provides text rendering tips for exact words, font details, and negative prompts.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account before use.
Prompts and reference image URLs are processed by the external inference.sh service.
Image quality, text accuracy, and edit fidelity depend on the hosted model response.
The skill does not include local model weights or offline image generation.

use_cases.title: Design Text-Heavy Posters
use_cases.description: Create posters with exact headline text, font direction, layout details, and negative prompts for cleaner typography.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Banners
use_cases.description: Generate marketing banners with specified dimensions, sale text, background style, and multiple variations.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Edits
use_cases.description: Use reference images to test outfit changes, style transfer, and concept edits before production work.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use qwen-image-2-pro to create a futuristic cityscape at sunset. Use a wide landscape format and return the generated image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Poster With Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Readable typography in a design asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use qwen-image-2-pro to create a poster. The title must read "GRAND OPENING" in large red serif text at the top center. Add elegant gold and white styling.

prompt_templates.title: Edit Reference Images
prompt_templates.prompt: Use qwen-image-2-pro with my provided reference images. Keep the person from the first image and apply the outfit style from the second image.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Production Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Use qwen-image-2-pro to create four campaign banner variants. Use 1920 by 1080 dimensions, a fixed seed, exact sale text, and a negative prompt for blurry text.

output_examples.input: Create a square social post for a book launch with the title clearly visible.
output_examples.output: A generated square image with the requested title, balanced layout, and a clean promotional style.

output_examples.input: Make three banner variations for a summer sale campaign.
output: Three generated banner images in the requested format.
Each variation keeps the sale text prominent and changes the background composition.

output_examples.input: Apply the outfit style from one reference image to the person in another reference image.
output_examples.output: An edited image that preserves the subject while applying the requested outfit direction.

best_practices: Put exact visible text in quotes and describe its position, color, and font style.
Choose dimensions before generation so the model composes for the final format.
Use negative prompts for blurry text, low quality, or unwanted visual artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not include private information, credentials, or confidential images in prompts.
Do not rely on prompt extension when exact wording must appear in the image.
Do not pass untrusted image URLs without confirming they are safe to process.

faq.question: What model does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh app runner.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. It requires the inference.sh CLI, authentication, and network access to the hosted model.

faq.question: Can it render readable text?
faq.answer: The skill is designed for text-heavy prompts and gives guidance for exact words, fonts, and negative prompts.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports reference-image workflows for edits such as style transfer and outfit changes.

faq.question: How many images can it request?
faq.answer: The documented num_images option supports one to six generated images per request.

faq.question: What should users avoid sending?
faq.answer: Users should avoid secrets, sensitive personal images, and reference URLs they do not trust.
